note.zh-TW: 日本基準的繰延資産；台灣現行報表沒有這一類。
note.en: The Japanese GAAP deferred assets; current Taiwanese statements have no such category.

definition.zh-TW: 教材把設立費、開發費等已經付了錢、但想分幾年認列為費用的支出，先放在這一組資產裡。模板的分組標題。
definition.en: The course places costs that have been paid but are to be expensed over several years, such as start-up and development costs, in this asset group. A template group heading.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 沒有遞延資產這一類：設立費依 IAS 38.69 在發生時費用化，開發支出只有符合 IAS 38.57 條件的部分才列為無形資產。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS has no deferred asset category: start-up costs are expensed when incurred under IAS 38.69, and development costs are capitalised as intangible assets only when the IAS 38.57 conditions are met.
